title: Revision 24: sequential synthetic proving supervisor, observer, closure, manifest and mandatory observer-result gate (source only)

manifestCoherence.sliceDerivation: fixture markers unique; 28 lines + trailing LF; occurs once in counter parent; sha 58cf74d1

supervisor.envelope: outer age sampled once from Process.StartTime + Stopwatch (F-Outer) checked before admission (2000 reserve), before output (5000), per case, after post pins, after receipt write and on the final exit line
supervisor.admission: accepted counter slice lines 138-165 with its own 30 s startup fence; real OS/available/commit >= 512 MiB; independent of fixture mocks
supervisor.ticket: hash == arg; approved/mode sequential-synthetic-proving/group/owner/output attempt-<group>-r1/exclusiveExecutionReserved; per-group bounds + counterOperationTimeoutSec 2; invocation exactly [pwsh,-NoProfile,-File,<self>,-ProvingGroup,<group>] normalized; window <= 20 min, lastStart == ends-(aggregate/1000+45) s; manifestSha256
supervisor.inputs: group pin paths == required set exactly (counter 7 / scheme 9 incl. self, observer, closure); closed ordered case names; each case command == literal expected array; pins hashed pre/post; slice containment re-derived pre/post; pinned pwsh runtime; output absent; ancestors reparse-free
supervisor.perCase: cleared env; retained-handle identity with expected executable from the case command (pwsh or node), doc 118 loop; 1 KiB async reads, 16 KiB combined; exit == expectedExitCode and lifetime < 5000; output contract; partials preserved; dispose after exit; no stops

contracts.refusal: stdout exactly empty; stderr == bare token after trimming trailing CR/LF only (error records fail)
contracts.success: stderr empty; exactly one JSON line (CRLF normalized); closed keys; kind/case/calls 2/booleans false; numeric finite non-negative; expected MiB; floor 512; timeout 2; read < 2000; before+2000 < 30000; after < 30000; after >= before; UTC timestamp
contracts.schemeTap: no not ok/Bail out/SKIP/TODO; exactly 19 'ok N - name' and 19 '# Subtest: name' in manifest order; 'TAP version 13', '1..19', '# tests 19', '# suites 0', '# pass 19', '# fail 0', '# cancelled 0', '# skipped 0', '# todo 0' each exactly once

supervisor.finalization: post pins + slice + manifest/ticket hashes; PRELIMINARY_SYNTHETIC_GROUP_PROVEN_REQUIRES_OUTER_EXIT_AND_CLOSURE or FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE; finalizationStop min(aggregate, start+10000); terminal-failure on overrun; exit 0 only if no failure, all cases passed/closed and all clocks incl. real outer unexpired

observer.binding: ticket hash/scope; after 200 ms exactly one other pwsh.exe whose command line contains the supervisor path, with -ProvingGroup <group> and -AdmissionSha256 <hash>; retained handle; handle vs CIM creation <= 1 ms; executable == pinned pwsh; parent must be cmd.exe
observer.records: PROVING_OUTER_OBSERVER row; WaitForExit up to aggregate+15 s; PROVING_OUTER_UNCLOSED + exit 3 if not exited; PROVING_OUTER_EXIT row with exit/lifetime; exit 1 unless exit 0, lifetime < aggregate and own clock within window
observer.gap: rows do not prove the observer's own exit/elapsed/stream completion (it can emit both rows and exit 1 on its own clock) -> resolved by the mandatory external gate

closure.binds: ticket, manifest, observer.stdout.bin <= 16 KiB hash == parameter, exactly 2 rows (group/hash/stops 0, same parent pid/creation, recomputed lifetime within 0.01 ms, exit 0, lifetime < aggregate), receipt (parent identity, PRELIMINARY status, group, hashes, no failure, full case count, no terminal-failure), each case (name, exit, lifetime < 5000, flags, identity fields, stream hashes, per-stream and combined 16 KiB)
closure.quiets: two CIM absence checks 500 ms apart over parent + cmd ancestor + observer + all child PIDs, plus ParentProcessId == scheme runner PID

addendum.resolution: external mandatory gate before closure and before any credit: observer identity (pinned pwsh, script hash c4dde5b6, group, ticket hash, PID == first row observerPid), exit exactly 0, OS creation-to-exit < 135000 ms counter / < 45000 ms scheme, complete stdout/stderr to EOF with stderr empty and bytes/lengths/hashes preserved, no retry/stop, recorded before closure; future ticket binds the addendum hash
addendum.combinedAcceptance: exact outputs + parent/children success AND gate PASS AND independent known-scope closure; none substitutes
addendum.outputsExistClarification: handoff outputsAbsent:false means outputsExist:false, matching STATIC_SOURCE_BYTE_PROOF; outputs absent on disk

workerLimit.fact: Node 20 runs each --test file in a separate child process; supervisor measures only the direct runner (handle creation/exit/lifetime < 5 s, exit code aggregates the child, stdout relays TAP); inner process creation/exit/lifetime not individually captured; closure checks absence of any process with ParentProcessId == runner PID twice (parent PIDs persist on Windows after parent exit)
workerLimit.disposition: ACCEPTED_FOR_THE_SCHEME_PROVING_GROUP_ONLY: the canary (doc 127) reads two pinned files and performs no network/browser/application action, so an undetected straggler could only be a Node process holding those files
notInferred: transfer to browser diagnostic, controls or any scope with external effects

prerequisites: execution owner with exclusive slot and the applicable human-scope comparison for the exact runtime authority (recorded authoring scope is not that comparison)

concrete launcher: supervisor as direct child of cmd.exe with literal invocation + -AdmissionSha256; observer started with same group/hash after the supervisor exists and before it exits (zero or several candidates fails); observer stdout/stderr captured to EOF <= 16 KiB with exit code and retained-handle creation/exit; gate record with hashes; then observer.stdout.bin written and closure invoked with its hash

per group, counter then scheme: fresh finite ticket at the fixed path (mode, group, owner, attempt-<group>-r1, exclusive reservation, group bounds, counterOperationTimeoutSec 2, literal invocation, real window, manifestSha256, addendum hash); consumed ticket archived before the next; never reused
fresh 512 MiB admission inside the supervisor; pre/post pins with binaries actually rehashed; outputs absent beforehand

acceptance only when exact outputs + parent exit 0 + every child < 5 s with its contract + real parent lifetime < group aggregate, AND externally captured observer gate PASS, AND independent known-scope closure with post pins and immutability

establishesWhenPassed.counter: exact 28-line slice refuses empty/multiple/missing/null/negative/non-finite readings, late return, propagates throw, applies three floors + negative headroom, accepts exact floor, records four timing fields, in fifteen fresh processes
establishesWhenPassed.scheme: extracted handler maps 12 schemes, unknown, relative and malformed to the enum; no canary byte; record shape, acceptance, refusal and 64 cap unchanged
